name: cheap+signal (nix2)
one_line: Buy the underpriced side when the oracle-lag signal confirms it and the book is fillable; skip toxic-cheap, spikes, and thin books.
why_it_works: EV = win-rate vs entry PRICE, not win-rate alone. The book sometimes underprices a side (crowd piled the other way); the Binance-vs-Chainlink oracle lag independently says that side just ticked up. Cheap + confirmation = a mispricing, not information. Profit is price leverage (win ~52% at ~0.47 = +6-9%/trade), not direction skill.

entry_rules.fill: taker at signal-side top-of-book at T0+250ms, walk book if thin

in_sample_evidence.stability: win rate identical train(51.1)/val(51.1); positive every month; fresh Jul6-8 positive
in_sample_evidence.caveats: NOT pre-registered (found after 6 passes -> discount p); 5m recent era only; small capacity (~$10/trade, decays by $25); pooled with 15m not significant

PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.rule: FROZEN above — do not change any parameter
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.bar: positive EV AND daily-EV t >= 2.0 over >= 20 trade-days
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.if_pass: real edge confirmed -> paper-live then small real stakes
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.if_fail: in-sample mirage -> report negative, do not retune

V2_PRE_REGISTERED.rule: v1 + require signal-side book q_imb < -0.05 at decision (book leans AWAY = mispricing fingerprint). All other parameters identical to v1.
V2_PRE_REGISTERED.evidence: train Feb-Mar keep 53.6% vs dropped 50.8%; val Apr-May keep 59.0% vs dropped 54.8%; EV ~2x per trade at ~half the trade count. Only candidate of 4 consistent in BOTH halves. Rejected: spread filter (sign flip), z sub-band (no val lift), hour-of-day (sign flip), late-TP 0.90/0.95 exit (EV identical to hold, negligible variance gain).
V2_PRE_REGISTERED.deployment: parallel paper account 'paper2' with --qimb-max -0.05; v1 test untouched
V2_PRE_REGISTERED.bar: same as v1: total>0 AND daily-EV t>=2.0 over >=20 trade-days, judged independently

V3_PRE_REGISTERED.rule: v1 signal+gates, but fill by WALKING the ask ladder instead of skipping thin books; stake $25; refuse if the walk climbs past 0.55.
V3_PRE_REGISTERED.why: Fill audit (src/nix_fillaudit.py): skip-if-thin drops windows as the stake grows (596/443/314 at $10/$25/$50), which is what created the false 'capacity caps at $10-15' conclusion. Walking keeps ~100% of windows at ~8.9% ROI: $25 -> $20.04/day vs $14.35 skip-thin; $50 -> $40.09 vs $21.03. At $10 the two tie, so v1 is NOT changed.
V3_PRE_REGISTERED.deployment: parallel paper account 'paper3' with --walk --stake 25; paper1 (v1) and paper2 (v2) untouched
V3_PRE_REGISTERED.bar: same as v1, judged independently: total>0 AND daily t>=2.0 over >=20 trade-days

RISK_ENGINE.sizing: 1% of bankroll per trade, floor $5, cap $50 — NOT Kelly (8-11% tolerates ruinous drawdowns). $10 stakes therefore need ~$1000 bankroll.
RISK_ENGINE.halts: drawdown >= 35% of bankroll; 12 consecutive losses; rolling decay t <= -1.5 over >=250 trades (window 400)
RISK_ENGINE.pause: daily loss >= 12 stakes, clears at UTC midnight
RISK_ENGINE.calibration: decay detector false-halts a LIVE edge 3.7% per 800 trades (the naive t<-1.5/n>=60/window120 setting did so 38% of the time); catches a -$0.50/trade dead edge 78-94% of the time, median ~335-426 trades
RISK_ENGINE.status: MONITOR ONLY during the paper test (settle.py replays it and reports state); ENFORCE when real money goes live

V4_REALISTIC_EXECUTION.problem: v1-v3 paper fills at the price OBSERVED at decision time (T0), which silently assumes the liquidity waited 250ms for our order. That is an optimistic simulation, not an execution test.
V4_REALISTIC_EXECUTION.rule: --realistic: at fill time RE-FETCH the book and fill against what is actually there, as a marketable LIMIT at (observed ask + 1 tick). Partial fills and no-fills are recorded honestly; P&L uses the notional ACTUALLY spent, not the intended stake.
V4_REALISTIC_EXECUTION.note: Still cannot model OTHER bots racing us for the same liquidity — historical/live book shows what IS there, not how it reacts to us taking it repeatedly. Paper remains an UPPER BOUND at large size; only small real orders settle that.
V4_REALISTIC_EXECUTION.bar: same as v1, judged independently: total>0 AND daily t>=2.0 over >=20 trade-days
